protocol.test_set_selection_warning: Configuration and representative checkpoint are selected only from validation balanced-selection scores. Test metrics are final reporting.
protocol.selection_score: Equal mean of overall AUC, macro slot AUC, worst-slot AUC, and macro outfit-length AUC.

test_metrics.fitb4_protocol: One true completion and three same-slot replacements. One replacement is the matched negative; two are sampled deterministically from other test pairs. This is a project-specific diagnostic, not the official Polyvore FITB.
